hypotheses.storyTitle: Verify Statement Credit Accumulation & Goal Progress
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Daniel reviews his 7,300 LBG coin balance and tracks progress toward his holiday spending goal with direct statement credit allocation.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Daniel visits the rewards overview to check accumulated coins and monitor progress on his holiday spending savings goal.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring transparent, predictable value without confusing gamification or irrelevant voucher promotions.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear display of coin balance, guaranteed cash-equivalent conversion rates, and direct holiday savings goal milestones.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of payment-linked reward accumulation and clear insight into statement credit progress.
prohibitedDetours: Voucher or experience promotions not aligned with payment utility

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Daniel checks his 53% progress on the Holiday Spending Money goal to ensure his automatic payment allocations are on track.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Daniel wants to verify how close he is to reaching his 1,200 target for holiday spending.
hypotheses.storyTension: Need for precise, predictable tracking of tangible progress toward bill reduction.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Milestone breakdown displaying current value, remaining target, and automatic credit allocation status.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clear insight into statement credit progress and holiday spending goal attainment.
